summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated and, on install, downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, sets it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line bundle protected with obfuscator.io-style string-array + rotation obfuscation (rotator function, hex-constant array, and decoder), so the payload executed on the installer's machine at `npm install` time is opaque. The package is published as `eslint-plugin-folder-schema` and advertised as an ESLint plugin; an ESLint plugin has no legitimate need to download a second language runtime or execute a 727KB obfuscated bundle at install time. package.json lists `ServiceTitan` as author with homepage `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint` while the README contains only `TODO: description` / `TODO: Usage` placeholders and the shipped contents have no relationship to a folder-linting ESLint plugin — the author/homepage metadata does not match the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
